title: AgriConnect — Agricultural Marketplace
overview: An agricultural marketplace connecting product discovery, buyer and seller workflows, location-based browsing, and an OpenAI assistant. React and TypeScript interfaces connect to an Express API and a hosted PostgreSQL database.
features: Category-based product discovery, search, seller profiles, and map-based browsing
Guest and authenticated carts, saved addresses, orders, and seller workflows
OpenAI chat assistance, multilingual translation, product search, and voice-command interpretation
Organisation roles, administrator permissions, product moderation, and audit records
Regional commerce, logistics views, community sharing, and student resources
role: Extended the existing marketplace with configurable OpenAI workflows, validated API inputs, regression tests, hosted PostgreSQL migration, preserved administrator access, and Vercel deployment fixes.
challenges: Move a data-rich local marketplace to serverless hosting while preserving catalogue ownership, account permissions, and encrypted records; integrate bounded AI requests without bypassing authentication or exposing provider credentials.
impact: Combines agricultural discovery, commerce, and platform operations in one deployed application. The hosted database migration preserved 1,642 product records and existing administrator permissions. Commercial adoption and farmer-income outcomes have not been measured.
